messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help with a refund. I ordered a bicycle from you, and when it arrived, it was damaged. I’m really frustrated because it was expensive, and I want to get my money back as soon as possible. Can you help me with this?

I’m sorry that happened—I can help you request a refund/exchange for a delivered order, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please share the **email address** you used at checkout.
I actually don’t remember which email I used when I placed the order. Is there another way you can look up my account?

Yes—if you don’t remember your email, I can look up your account using your **first name, last name, and ZIP code**.

Please tell me:
1) First name  
2) Last name  
3) ZIP code
Sure. My first name is Sofia, my last name is Li, and my ZIP code is 78260.
